items.title_en: Physics-informed Bayesian optimization of high-order harmonic generation in gases
items.title_zh: 气体中高次谐波产生的物理信息贝叶斯优化
items.abstract_en: Optimization of high-order harmonic generation in gases is essential for attosecond science. Improving conversion efficiency from the infrared driving laser to the extreme-ultraviolet high-order harmonic radiation requires balancing microscopic single-atom dipole responses with macroscopic phase matching. The resulting conversion-efficiency landscape exhibits complex structures, such as the hyperbolic ridge in the pressure-length space, which can be difficult to accurately reconstruct using conventional Bayesian optimization. Here, we introduce a physics-informed Bayesian optimization framework that incorporates known physical scaling relations through nonlinear transformations of the search space. We first demonstrate the approach in the two-dimensional pressure-length space, where a direct grid scan enables detailed validation of the reconstructed landscape, before extending it to four dimensions, where exhaustive scanning becomes computationally impractical. In four dimensions, incorporating the pulse-duration scaling and a square-root transformation of conversion efficiency further improves the accuracy of the reconstructed landscape, as validated against an independent reference dataset. We also employ a threshold-based acquisition strategy to identify extended high-efficiency operating regions rather than isolated optimal points. Together, these results demonstrate that incorporating physical knowledge into Bayesian optimization improves the exploration and reconstruction of multidimensional high-order harmonic generation landscapes, extending its capabilities beyond locating individual optima.
items.abstract_zh: 优化气体中的高次谐波产生对阿秒科学至关重要。提高从红外驱动激光到极紫外高次谐波辐射的转换效率，需要平衡微观单原子偶极响应与宏观相位匹配。所得的转换效率景观呈现复杂结构，例如压力-长度空间中的双曲脊，使用传统贝叶斯优化难以准确重建。在此，我们引入一个物理信息贝叶斯优化框架，通过搜索空间的非线性变换纳入已知的物理缩放关系。我们首先在二维压力-长度空间中演示该方法，其中直接网格扫描可对重建景观进行详细验证，然后将其扩展到四维，在四维中穷举扫描在计算上变得不切实际。在四维中，纳入脉冲持续时间缩放和转换效率的平方根变换进一步提高了重建景观的准确性，并针对独立参考数据集进行了验证。我们还采用基于阈值的采集策略来识别扩展的高效运行区域，而不是孤立的最优点。总之，这些结果表明，将物理知识纳入贝叶斯优化可改善多维高次谐波产生景观的探索和重建，将其能力扩展到定位单个最优之外。

items.title_en: Learning Actionable Information Landscapes for Multimodal Active Sensing in Hawkmoths
items.title_zh: 天蛾多模态主动感知中可执行信息景观的学习
items.abstract_en: Animals integrate information across sensory modalities to guide exploration, suggesting that they maintain internal estimates of where actions are expected to reduce uncertainty. However, how such action-conditioned information maps are learned from multimodal sensory experience remains unclear, as previous studies have been largely confined to unimodal sensing frameworks. We introduce a multimodal predictive-coding framework for learning uncertainty-reduction maps from visual and mechanosensory observations in hawkmoth flower interaction tasks. A variational generative model trained on simulated environments recovers modality-specific information landscapes over the action space, capturing how visual patterns, surface geometry, and mechanosensory cues shape the value of exploratory actions. These learned maps are consistent with several features of hawkmoth behavior, including nonzero tracking offsets, probing along visual patterns, and geometry-dependent exploration. Applying the model to behavioral data from flower tracking and nectary search, we find that natural trajectories tend to occupy regions of high uncertainty reduction in these learned maps. Building on these observations, we develop an uncertainty-gated lexicographic algorithm that switches between information gathering and reward exploitation based on perceptual uncertainty. In nectary search, uncertainty gating improves learning relative to exploit-only, $ε$-greedy, fixed-time, and uncertainty-calibrated non-lexicographic controls, with better generalization and robustness to sensory and curvature shifts. These results link information landscapes learned through generative modeling to biological sensing and embodied exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 动物整合多种感觉模态来引导探索，提示其内部维持着“哪些行动可降低不确定性”的估计。然而这类以行动为条件的信息地图如何从多模态经验中习得仍不清楚，以往研究多限于单模态框架。我们提出一个多模态预测编码框架，从天蛾与花朵交互任务中的视觉与机械感觉观测中学习不确定性降低地图。在模拟环境训练的变分生成模型可恢复动作空间上各模态的信息景观，刻画视觉模式、表面几何与机械感觉线索如何塑造探索行动的价值；这些地图与天蛾行为的多项特征吻合，如非零跟踪偏移、沿视觉模式探测与几何依赖的探索。将模型用于花朵跟踪与花蜜搜索行为数据，发现自然轨迹偏好高不确定性降低区域；据此设计的不确定性门控字典序算法在花蜜搜索中优于多种对照策略，并更具泛化性与鲁棒性。
items.highlight_zh: 多模态预测编码还原天蛾信息景观，并用不确定性门控驱动探索
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：动物探索环境时并非被动接收信息，而是主动用多种感官（如视觉加触觉/气流感觉）决定“下一步去哪、摸哪”。一个合理假设是大脑内部维持一张地图，标出“做哪个动作最能减少不确定性”。但这样的地图如何从多模态经验中学出来，此前研究多局限在单一感觉通道，说不清楚。
2）方法：作者以天蛾采蜜为模型系统，构建多模态预测编码框架：用变分生成模型在模拟环境中接收视觉与机械感觉输入，学习以行动为条件的“不确定性降低”景观，即每个动作在降低不确定性上的价值。
3）结果：模型自行学出的信息地图重现了真实天蛾行为的若干特征——跟踪花朵时保持非零偏移、沿花冠的视觉纹理进行探测、探索方式随花朵几何形状而变化；把模型套用到真实的花朵跟踪和寻找花蜜行为数据上，发现自然轨迹确实更多落在信息增益高的区域。基于此设计的不确定性门控字典序算法（依据感知不确定性在“先探索”与“先利用奖励”之间切换），在花蜜搜索任务中优于只用奖励、ε-greedy、固定探索时间和不确定性标定但不分优先级等多种对照，泛化更好，对感知噪声和花形弯曲也更鲁棒。
4）为何重要：把生成模型学到的“信息地图”与真实动物行为对应起来，既为神经行为学提供了可检验的计算解释，也给出了可用于机器人主动感知的探索算法。

items.title_en: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
items.title_zh: Infrathon：面向真实世界长时程 AI 基础设施优化的语言智能体基准测试
items.abstract_en: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们研究前沿智能体能否在长时程内持续改进真实世界 AI 基础设施。我们提出 Infrathon，一个包含不同层级、多样化的长时程 AI 基础设施优化任务的基准。我们在 24 小时预算下评估六个模型共 150 次运行，总计超过 10,000 GPU 小时。结果表明，模型排名随评估时程变化，而 150 次运行中有 135 次在预算后半段取得进一步提升。这些发现表明，较短评估可能同时忽略优化收益和相对模型性能的变化。我们还发现智能体能够发现优于人工设计基线的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5 将平均 KV 缓存压缩率从人工设计的 Quant-VideoGen 编解码器的 6.82% 提高到 19.86%。对智能体轨迹的分析将任务违规、不可靠测试和过早完成识别为持续改进的障碍。总之，我们的 Infrathon 框架为构建长时程任务、评估前沿智能体和发现良好基础设施解决方案提供资源。

items.title_en: A computational framework for understanding embodied plans
items.title_zh: 理解具身计划的计算框架
items.abstract_en: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. Across several experiments spanning the qualitatively distinct domains of object manipulation and navigation, featuring diverse tasks and multiple behavioral measures, we show that GenEA, through simple transformations of this joint distribution, recapitulates how humans reason about embodied plans. Crucially, GenEA consistently outperforms strong alternative models, including plausible heuristics, standard task-and-motion planning, and a state-of-the-art vision-language model. GenEA thereby offers a new perspective on the architecture of human reasoning and social cognition, suggesting that embodied artificial intelligence systems seeking to seamlessly interact with humans should adopt GenEA-like generative models of action planning.
items.abstract_zh: 基于人们的行为推断其计划和目标，是人类社会互动的基础，也是实现协作型具身人工智能的必要条件。在自然主义、具身环境中形式化这一能力长期是一项挑战。在此，我们提出 GenEA，一种能够对多步骤、长时程具身计划进行推理的新型智能体表示。GenEA 的核心是一个多层级状态空间，它通过将机器人学中的任务与运动规划框架与基于仿真的直觉物理相结合，耦合了铰接身体的粗粒度生物力学及其与附近物体的交互。通过将该状态空间嵌入生成模型，GenEA 产生目标和具身计划的联合概率分布。在涵盖物体操作和导航这两个性质不同领域的若干实验中，包含多样任务和多种行为测量，我们表明 GenEA 通过该联合分布的简单变换，重现了人类如何推理具身计划。关键在于，GenEA 始终优于强替代模型，包括合理的启发式方法、标准任务与运动规划以及最先进的视觉语言模型。因此，GenEA 为人类推理和社会认知的架构提供了新视角，表明寻求与人类无缝交互的具身人工智能系统应采用类似 GenEA 的行动规划生成模型。

items.title_en: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
items.title_zh: PhysOPSD：以代码作为特权信息实现物理上合理的视频生成
items.abstract_en: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管现代视频生成模型实现了显著的视觉保真度，但在生成物理上合理的动力学和复杂交互时仍明显脆弱。有针对性的后训练至关重要，然而监督微调受离线状态失配困扰，强化学习则受稀疏且定义不良的物理奖励函数阻碍。同策略（自）蒸馏（OPSD）将同策略轨迹与稠密纠正反馈相协调，将核心挑战转向设计有效的特权上下文。然而，传统模态存在不足：文本提示本质上是声明式的，而真实参考视频在没有参数控制的情况下将物理规律与视觉外观严重纠缠。为此，我们提出 PhysOPSD，引入可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文。与静态视觉观察不同，可执行代码实例化一个可编辑的物理世界，具有内在的抽象性和可控性。借助 PhysOPSD-Engine，我们将真实世界物理场景转换为可验证的仿真程序。PhysOPSD 随后结合 (i) 双层物理特权，通过中间瓶颈弥合信息差距，以及 (ii) 在共享 rollout 噪声下的受控物理变化，以暴露因果动态变化。大量实验表明，PhysOPSD 在多种骨干网络上显著提升物理合理性，仅用 3K 样本即优于 SFT 和 RL 基线，同时保持通用视频生成质量。

items.title_en: LIMBER: A Hybrid RNA Foundation Model for Predicting and Understanding RNA Structure and Function
items.title_zh: 纯相位全息光镊阵列的强度极限
items.abstract_en: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model architecture shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pre-trained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. With task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of biological information across model layers. In addition, we demonstrate distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary, and functional capabilities by training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration, and dataset size. Taken together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide insight into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
items.abstract_zh: RNA 基础模型有望解码 RNA 序列、结构与功能的关系，但模型架构如何塑造生物信息的获取与组织仍不清楚。本文提出 LIMBER，一种将双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模相结合的混合基础模型，在 4050 万条非编码 RNA 序列上预训练。经任务微调后，LIMBER 在二级结构预测与非编码 RNA 分类基准上取得领先性能，并能良好迁移到翻译相关任务与 RNA—小分子相互作用预测。我们进一步建立统一、与任务无关的框架，系统评估模型内在习得的生物学知识，发现其能强有力地恢复 RNA 结构、预测突变效应，且生物信息在模型各层呈分层、任务依赖的组织方式；在容量、训练时长与数据规模的多种变体上，结构、进化与功能能力表现出不同的缩放行为。
items.highlight_zh: 混合架构 RNA 基础模型，并揭示模型内部知识的分层组织
items.digest_zh:
1）要解决的问题：RNA 的功能由序列和折叠结构共同决定，但实验测定又贵又慢。近年 RNA 领域也在建“基础模型”（类似蛋白质大模型），可是不同网络架构会让模型学到什么、这些知识在网络的哪一层、如何组织，一直缺乏系统认识。
2）方法：作者提出 LIMBER，把两种互补的结构“交错”堆叠：双向自注意力擅长捕捉序列远距离的相互配对（如碱基互补），Mamba 选择性状态空间模型则擅长高效处理长序列。模型在 4050 万条非编码 RNA 上预训练，再针对具体任务微调。同时建立一套与任务无关的统一评估与解释框架，用探针分析各层表征。
3）结果：在二级结构预测和非编码 RNA 分类两个基准上达到领先水平，还能迁移到翻译相关任务以及 RNA 与小分子结合预测；模型确实“学会”了结构并能预测突变效应；不同层负责不同层次、不同任务的信息；通过训练多种容量、时长、数据规模的变体，发现结构、进化、功能三类能力的缩放规律各不相同。
4）为何重要：既交付了一个多用途的 RNA 基础模型，也提供了一套“读懂模型学到了什么”的方法论，对靶向 RNA 的药物设计和后续基础模型架构选择都有参考价值。

items.title_en: SGAA: Independent active alignment of optical subgroups with uncompensated aberrations
items.title_zh: SGAA：具有未补偿像差的光学子组的独立主动对准
items.abstract_en: Uncompensated subgroup aberrations complicate subgroup-level active alignment (AA), as local image-quality extrema do not directly indicate the target alignment state. We propose SGAA, an image-learning-based method for independent active alignment of optical subgroups. Multi-field point spread functions (PSFs) from a dedicated test configuration characterize misalignment, while golden-sample reference calibration and unified regression predict adjustments toward a common optical target across toleranced specimens. In simulations with tolerances, one step reduced the mean differential wavefront RMS from $0.0592λ$ to $0.0086λ$, an 85.4% reduction. In alignment experiments on 100 production subgroups, SGAA increased the mean full-lens weighted modulation transfer function (WMTF) at 30, 50, and 80 lp/mm by 0.073, 0.065, and 0.040, respectively, relative to industrial MTF-based scanning. The 8 MP acceptance yield increased by 29.2 percentage points, and mean alignment time decreased from 43 s to 3.1 s. SGAA thus translates independent subgroup reference-state restoration into gains in full-lens imaging, acceptance yield, and alignment speed.
items.abstract_zh: 未补偿的亚组像差使亚组级主动对准（AA）复杂化，因为局部图像质量极值并不直接指示目标对准状态。我们提出 SGAA，一种基于图像学习的光学亚组独立主动对准方法。来自专用测试配置的多视场点扩散函数（PSF）表征失准，而金样参考校准和统一回归预测朝向跨公差样本共同光学目标的调整。在带公差的仿真中，一步将平均差分波前 RMS 从 $0.0592λ$ 降至 $0.0086λ$，降低 85.4%。在 100 个生产亚组的对准实验中，相对于工业基于 MTF 的扫描，SGAA 将 30、50 和 80 lp/mm 处的平均全镜头加权调制传递函数（WMTF）分别提高 0.073、0.065 和 0.040。8 MP 验收良率提高 29.2 个百分点，平均对准时间从 43 秒降至 3.1 秒。因此，SGAA 将独立亚组参考状态恢复转化为全镜头成像、验收良率和对准速度方面的收益。

items.title_en: When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
items.title_zh: 真实连接何时胜出？用未测量生理学检验连接组结构-功能主张
items.abstract_en: Connectome-constrained models are often used to argue that a measured wiring diagram outperforms shuffled or rewired wiring, and hence that structure shapes function. Such comparisons can confound wiring with how the models are tuned: a connectome fixes who connects to whom, not the excitability, gains or plasticity rates the model also needs, and modellers often tune these until the real-wiring model works. We separate three estimands: physiology tuned on the real wiring and transferred to nulls (P1), each wiring tuned on its own (P2), and P2 restricted to physiology consistent with independent data (P3). The biases involved are known in machine learning (under-tuned baselines, inherited weights, winner's curse); we measure what they do to biological conclusions, using synthetic ground truth, placebo nulls and three Drosophila circuit models. Some claims survive every protocol we test: segregated reward and punishment dopamine improves learning, and head-direction topography is required for a persistent bump. Others do not. In the mushroom body, the real Kenyon-cell output wiring beats a cross-subtype identity shuffle by 0.09 under P1 and P2 but loses to it by 0.09 under P3 (95% CIs exclude zero; held-out runs confirm). The verdict is set by the share of alpha'beta' cells among active Kenyon cells, which P1 selects low; at the share implied by imaging (about 44%) the real-wiring model fails to learn, exposing a model inadequacy rather than a deficit of the fly's wiring. In flyvis, P1 penalises a mirrored connectome, which has a constructed solution within 0.07 (median) of the real error, more than a spatially shuffled one in 50 of 50 members; the ranking survives ten-fold longer retraining but depends on the checkpoint at fifty-fold. A credible structural claim needs matched optimisation, data-constrained physiology and a model that still works there.
items.abstract_zh: 受连接组约束的模型常被用来主张，测量得到的接线图优于打乱或重连的接线，从而结构塑造功能。此类比较可能将接线与模型调参方式混淆：连接组固定谁与谁连接，而不固定模型同样需要的兴奋性、增益或可塑性速率，建模者常调整这些参数直到真实接线模型奏效。我们分离三种估计目标：在真实接线上调参并迁移到零模型的生理参数（P1）、每种接线各自调参（P2）、以及将 P2 限制为与独立数据一致的生理参数（P3）。涉及的偏差在机器学习中已知（调参不足的基线、继承权重、赢家诅咒）；我们使用合成真值、安慰剂零模型和三个果蝇回路模型测量它们对生物学结论的影响。有些主张在我们测试的每种协议下都成立：分离的奖赏和惩罚多巴胺改善学习，且持久凸起需要头方向拓扑。其他主张则不然。在蘑菇体中，真实 Kenyon 细胞输出接线在 P1 和 P2 下以 0.09 的优势胜过跨亚型身份打乱，但在 P3 下以 0.09 的劣势输给它（95% 置信区间排除零；留出运行予以确认）。裁决由活跃 Kenyon 细胞中 alpha'beta' 细胞的比例决定，而 P1 选择的比例较低；在成像所暗示的比例（约 44%）下，真实接线模型无法学习，暴露出模型不足而非果蝇接线缺陷。在 flyvis 中，P1 对镜像连接组的惩罚在 50/50 个成员中都比对空间打乱连接组更重，而镜像连接组有一个构造解，其误差中位数在真实误差的 0.07 以内；该排名在延长十倍的重新训练后仍保持，但在延长五十倍时取决于检查点。可信的结构主张需要匹配优化、受数据约束的生理参数以及在那里仍然有效的模型。

items.title_en: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models
items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的语言模型中 inside-outside 计算的分阶段且可解释的涌现
items.abstract_en: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.
items.abstract_zh: 句法结构的可变性和解析歧义是自然语言的基本方面，现代 LLM 必须学会熟练处理。此前的“事后”研究表明，完全训练的 Transformer 确实近似 inside-outside 等典型解析算法，但关于这实际上如何被学习，理论上尚无多少确立。在此，我们通过研究具有可变解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关文法中的学习动力学，朝解决这一问题迈出第一步。分阶段学习曲线完全可解释，意思是所有损失阶段 a) 可以解析计算，且 b) 可以清晰地与隐藏潜在树变量的表示相关联，从而消除歧义并利用更广上下文的信息。通过探测表示，我们可视化了 inside-outside 计算在深度和训练过程中的涌现：早期阶段使用局部（二元/三元）信息且仅涉及少数初始层，随后 Transformer 逐渐发展出编码器-解码器结构，其中最抽象的潜在信息编码在中间，网络后半部分用于逐步细化最终词元预测。这种计算组织让人联想到真实世界 LLM 中的发现，并且重要的是，这里适用于一个允许对数据统计进行完全解析控制的合成模型，从而为理论进展打开大门。

items.title_en: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
items.title_zh: DPGS-SLAM：面向动态视觉感知的扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DPGS-SLAM（扩散先验与来源感知单目高斯泼溅 SLAM），用于包含动态对象的环境中的稠密建图。在视觉 SLAM（同时定位与建图）中，动态观测可能污染相机跟踪和场景重建。尽管 3DGS（3D 高斯泼溅）能够实现高效稠密建图，但现有 3DGS-SLAM 系统在动态对象违反其底层静态场景假设时可能表现出不稳定性。排除动态观测可以减少其对跟踪和建图的影响，但可能使被遮挡的静态背景缺失或约束较弱。我们提出的 DPGS-SLAM 是一个单目 RGB SLAM 框架，通过基于扩散的异步背景补全和来源感知高斯建图，支持对观测不足的静态背景进行临时表征。动态区域通过基于光流的运动发现和 SAM2（segment anything model 2）的时间一致掩码传播来识别。对于选定的关键帧，微调扩散修复模型在遮挡区域生成合理的背景外观，同时 Metric3D v2 从补全图像预测度量深度以初始化临时高斯基元。来源标签区分生成基元与观测支持的基元，将生成内容排除在相机位姿估计和观测地图优化之外。当先前被遮挡的背景变为可见时，符合条件的生成基元被移除，观测支持的基元由真实 RGB 观测和预测深度独立初始化。实验结果表明具有竞争力的相机跟踪，在 TUM RGB-D 上平均 ATE RMSE 为 1.2 cm，在 BONN RGB-D 上为 2.7 cm。在 StaDy4D 上，DPGS-SLAM 仅使用单目 RGB 输入，相比 WildGS-SLAM 将平均 PSNR 提高 4.60 dB。

items.title_en: OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models
items.title_zh: OnlyAct：从基础模型中提取用于世界模型的动作表示
items.abstract_en: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.
items.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型有望成为通用交互式模拟器，但其训练受限于动作监督：动作标签稀缺、分散在不兼容的规范中，且无法随未标注视频预训练语料一起扩展。一种常见的变通方法是联合训练动作编码器将连续帧压缩为潜在动作，以及训练解码器由前一帧和该潜在动作重建下一帧，迫使潜在表示只捕获新信息。这有两个局限：从零学习动作空间会限制对未见域的泛化；瓶颈以表达性换取分离性，较紧的设置会丢失细节，较松的设置则在域偏移下存在场景泄漏的风险。我们主张一个不同的起点：不从零学习动作，而是从预训练基础模型（V-JEPA 2）出发，其帧对的嵌入在经过大规模、多样化视频预训练后已携带大量动作信息。剩下的挑战是在丢弃场景的同时提取动作。我们提出一个无标签对比自适应框架，将不同场景下具有相同运动的帧对拉近，将同一场景中不同运动的帧对推开，在不施加重建瓶颈的情况下重塑预训练空间的几何结构。我们引入一个沿三个轴（动作表达性、场景不变性和动作条件视频生成质量）的统一评估协议，覆盖机器人操作、相机导航、游戏和驾驶基准，其中大多数在自适应期间未见。与无标注潜在动作方法相比，我们的表示表达性显著更强，同时匹配其场景不变性，并且它们产生的世界模型能更忠实地将演示动作迁移到新场景。

items.title_en: Uncovering Viral Signals Across Cell Populations in Colorectal Cancer
items.title_zh: 揭示结直肠癌中跨细胞群体的病毒信号
items.abstract_en: Viral sequences have been detected in colorectal cancer, but their cellular and anatomical distribution remains poorly resolved. We aimed to establish a cell-type-resolved map of viral reference-associated RNA signals across colorectal cancer, tumour-adjacent normal tissue, and healthy colon. We repurposed human-unmapped reads from single-cell RNA sequencing libraries generated in ten publicly available studies. We retained cell-barcode and unique molecular identifier information, removed duplicate molecules, and aligned reads to a curated human-associated viral reference using three aligners. Viral signals were analysed across cell types, tissue conditions, and colorectal segments. We used participant-grouped repeated cross-validation to evaluate tissue-condition classification and screened an independent paired colorectal cancer proteomics cohort for compatible peptide matches. The study included 547 libraries from 112 participants, including 49 with matched colorectal cancer and tumour-adjacent normal samples, and approximately 415,000 cells spanning ten major cell populations. Viral reference-associated RNA signals differed across epithelial, immune, stromal, and vascular compartments, tissue conditions, and anatomical regions of the colon. Of 318 independent healthy-reference viral-load comparisons, seven involving six virus-cell-type groups remained significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction, including plasma-cell HHV-7 and HHV-6B and mast-cell HCV-2. Cell-type-resolved viral features distinguished colorectal cancer, tumour-adjacent normal tissue, and healthy colon in participant-grouped validation; random forest achieved a macro-AUC of 0.957 (SD 0.028), with HERV-K113 as the leading quantitative feature. An independent proteomic screen identified peptide matches compatible with 20 candidate viral groups. We established a cell-type-resolved map of viral reference-associated RNA signals across colorectal tissue conditions and anatomical regions. By identifying candidate viral signals in epithelial and immune compartments, this map provides a basis for investigating virus-host pathways involved in tumour biology, immune regulation, and antigen-presentation states, and could help prioritise future combination strategies pairing virus-directed or virus-mimetic approaches with standard treatment or immune checkpoint blockade.
items.abstract_zh: 在结直肠癌中已检测到病毒序列，但其细胞和解剖分布仍不清楚。我们旨在建立跨结直肠癌、肿瘤邻近正常组织和健康结肠的、细胞类型分辨的病毒参考相关 RNA 信号图谱。我们重新利用了来自十项公开研究的单细胞 RNA 测序文库中未比对到人类基因组的 reads。我们保留了细胞条形码和唯一分子标识符信息，去除了重复分子，并使用三种比对器将 reads 比对到精选的人类相关病毒参考序列。我们跨细胞类型、组织状态和结直肠分段分析了病毒信号。我们使用按参与者分组的重复交叉验证来评估组织状态分类，并在一个独立配对结直肠癌蛋白质组队列中筛选相容的肽段匹配。该研究纳入了来自112名参与者的547个文库，其中包括49名具有匹配结直肠癌和肿瘤邻近正常样本的参与者，以及横跨十个主要细胞群体的约415,000个细胞。病毒参考相关 RNA 信号在上皮、免疫、基质和血管区室、组织状态以及结肠解剖区域之间存在差异。在318项独立的健康参考病毒载量比较中，涉及六个病毒-细胞类型组的七项在 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正后仍显著，包括浆细胞 HHV-7 和 HHV-6B 以及肥大细胞 HCV-2。在按参与者分组的验证中，细胞类型分辨的病毒特征能够区分结直肠癌、肿瘤邻近正常组织和健康结肠；随机森林达到0.957的宏平均 AUC（标准差0.028），其中 HERV-K113 是首要定量特征。一项独立的蛋白质组筛选识别出与20个候选病毒组相容的肽段匹配。我们建立了跨结直肠组织状态和解剖区域的、细胞类型分辨的病毒参考相关 RNA 信号图谱。通过识别上皮和免疫区室中的候选病毒信号，该图谱为研究参与肿瘤生物学、免疫调节和抗原呈递状态的病毒-宿主通路提供了基础，并可能有助于优先考虑将病毒导向或病毒模拟方法与标准治疗或免疫检查点阻断配对的未来联合策略。

items.title_en: Additively manufactured ceramic platforms for miniaturized optical frequency references and robust atomic sensor systems
items.title_zh: 用于小型化光学频率参考和稳健原子传感器系统的增材制造陶瓷平台
items.abstract_en: Transferring atomic quantum sensors from laboratory-scale physics packages to compact, alignment-free sensor heads suitable for field and space deployment requires a structural platform that combines mechanical, thermal, and optical functionality within a single, manufacturable component. We present such a platform based on additively manufactured technical ceramics: lithography-based ceramic manufacturing is used to fabricate monolithic micro-optical benches with application-specific mounting geometries, while high-precision active alignment and adhesive bonding realize long-term stable optical assemblies through micro-integration. As a first system-level demonstrator, we present a micro-integrated optical frequency reference based on Doppler-free spectroscopy of the rubidium D2 line, integrated within a 6 mL Al2O3 module. A laser stabilized to the reference reaches a fractional frequency instability of $3\times10^{-12}$ at 1 s. We extend the platform to a compact optically pumped magnetometer, exploiting the magnetic cleanliness and tailored thermal properties of high-purity ceramics for a 7 mL sensor head with picotesla sensitivity aimed at space-borne biomagnetometry, and to a micro-integrated optical dipole trap with active MEMS-mirror beam steering for cold-atom manipulation. Together, these demonstrators show that ceramic additive manufacturing and optical micro-integration form a versatile, robust platform for compact atomic sensor systems in field and space applications.
items.abstract_zh: 将原子量子传感器从实验室规模的物理组件包转移到适合现场和空间部署的紧凑、免对准传感器头，需要一个在单一可制造组件内结合机械、热和光学功能的结构平台。我们提出这样一个基于增材制造技术陶瓷的平台：使用基于光刻的陶瓷制造来制造具有应用特定安装几何形状的单片微光学平台，同时通过微集成实现高精度主动对准和粘合剂键合，以实现长期稳定的光学组件。作为首个系统级演示器，我们提出一个基于铷 D2 线无多普勒光谱的微集成光学频率参考，集成在 6 mL 的 Al2O3 模块内。稳定到该参考的激光器在 1 s 处达到 $3\times10^{-12}$ 的分数频率不稳定度。我们将该平台扩展到紧凑的光泵磁力计，利用高纯陶瓷的磁洁净性和定制热特性，实现具有皮特斯拉灵敏度的 7 mL 传感器头，面向星载生物磁测量，并扩展到具有主动 MEMS 反射镜光束转向的微集成光学偶极阱，用于冷原子操控。总之，这些演示器表明，陶瓷增材制造和光学微集成构成了一个多功能、稳健的平台，适用于现场和空间应用中的紧凑原子传感器系统。

items.title_en: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.title_zh: 分子相互作用基础模型中涌现的生物能力
items.abstract_en: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
items.abstract_zh: 在大型未标注语料上训练的基础模型会发展出涌现能力，即超越训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，一个在约 3.2 万亿 token 的配对蛋白质-配体序列上训练的分子相互作用基础模型。从单一表示空间，Bonbon 在分层分辨率上展现出三种零样本涌现能力：功能（作用机制）、残基（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构区分）和键（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力都能泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅用蛋白质-配体序列训练，没有任何任务特定监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从 42M 到 1.6B 参数的六个模型规模上进行了受控缩放实验；在连续指标上，所有评估的能力都在最大规模处出现急剧跃升，即使预训练损失平滑下降。这表明仅靠基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时可用。这里报告的能力出现在以 1:2,000 参数-token 比训练之后，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。相同的冻结表示在结合和亲和力预测上达到最先进水平，速度比共折叠方法快五个数量级。在跨越七个蛋白质家族的九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 对从头化合物的剂量反应命中率达到 61.5%，产生以前未报道能抑制这些蛋白质的结构新颖分子，包括对分布外靶点。

items.title_en: Sckwoky at SHROOM-Visions: Character-Level Hallucination-Span Detection in Image-Conditioned VLMs via Dual-Prompted LoRA Decoders
items.title_zh: Sckwoky 在 SHROOM-Visions：通过双提示 LoRA 解码器在图像条件 VLM 中进行字符级幻觉跨度检测
items.abstract_en: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍我们在 SHROOM-visions 2026 共享任务上的系统，该任务针对图像条件视觉-语言模型（VLM）响应中的字符级幻觉跨度检测，跨英语、法语、意大利语和中文评估。检测器建立在冻结的 Gemma-4-12B-it 主干上，带有可训练 LoRA 适配器（约 1070 万参数）。由于主干是因果解码器，从答案的单一副本读取的隐藏状态无法关注后续 token；因此我们在一个提示中重复候选答案，并从其第二次出现中提取特征，从而在单次非自回归传递中为每个位置提供近似双向上下文。字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率、BIO 边界和响应级弃权分数，而单独的语言特定分类器为每个预测跨度分配五种幻觉类型之一。在封闭测试集上，我们的系统达到宏平均字符 IoU 0.4404，超过官方基线（0.1854）一倍以上，并在四种语言的 IoU 上排名第 5-6 位。在英语调参划分上，受控消融将增益归因于重复答案，其效果与 LoRA 适应相当（其留出增益较小且集中在幻觉答案上），并表明检测器依赖图像-答案配对：跨示例打乱图像会使每种语言的 IoU 降至预测空值下限或以下。在同一个 Gemma-4-12B-it 模型也生成答案的部署中，其基础权重可以复用，使该方法适用于无法运行单独验证器的本地问答系统。

items.title_en: Beyond Memory Limits: A Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Map Representation for Large-Scale 3D Autonomous Exploration
items.title_zh: 超越内存限制：面向大规模三维自主探索的层次化时空地图表示
items.abstract_en: Autonomous UAV exploration is increasingly used for large-scale surveying and inspection in inaccessible or disaster-affected environments, where onboard memory and computational resources are often severely constrained. Most existing UAV exploration systems maintain globally queryable geometric map representations for motion planning and exploration decision-making, causing memory consumption and spatial-query costs to increase with the explored area. Robot-centric local mapping bounds dense-map memory and computation but discards global task context needed for long-horizon exploration.We present FLAVOR, a hierarchical spatio-temporal framework that confines dense metric geometry to a robot-centric local map while retaining compact global observation and task context. At the observation level, lightweight LiDAR-keyframe visibility records preserve ray-wise evidence for frontier reasoning. At the task level, unresolved frontiers beyond the local-map extent are retained as compact pending tasks associated with odometry anchors. A sparse topological graph connects these anchors through retained routes for future revisits.Upon returning to a task region, FLAVOR reconstructs the frontier and exploration viewpoint from observations, while the topological route is instantiated and validated against the current local map before execution. Dense-map capacity remains fixed as exploration expands, with exploration-dependent memory growth confined to compact observation and task context.FLAVOR achieves 31.98--41.88% shorter exploration time and a 94--99% smaller map memory footprint than the best baseline that completes all three simulated scenes. In real-world deployments, it reduces this footprint by 92.67% in the forest and 62.42% at the construction site relative to an explicit point-cloud ikd-tree while preserving long-term task continuity under constrained onboard resources.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）探索越来越多地用于难以进入或受灾环境中的大规模测绘与巡检，而这些场景中机载内存与计算资源往往严重受限。现有大多数无人机探索系统为运动规划与探索决策维护可全局查询的几何地图表示，导致内存消耗与空间查询成本随已探索区域增大而增加。以机器人为中心的局部建图可限制稠密地图的内存与计算，但会丢弃长时程探索所需的全局任务上下文。我们提出FLAVOR，一个层次化时空框架，将稠密度量几何限制在以机器人为中心的局部地图内，同时保留紧凑的全局观测与任务上下文。在观测层，轻量级LiDAR关键帧可见性记录保留用于前沿推理的逐射线证据。在任务层，超出局部地图范围的未解决前沿被保留为与里程计锚点关联的紧凑待处理任务。稀疏拓扑图通过保留的路线连接这些锚点，以供未来重访。当返回某任务区域时，FLAVOR从观测中重建前沿与探索视点，拓扑路线在执行前被实例化并针对当前局部地图进行验证。随着探索扩展，稠密地图容量保持固定，依赖探索的内存增长仅局限于紧凑的观测与任务上下文。FLAVOR相比完成全部三个仿真场景的最佳基线，探索时间缩短31.98--41.88%，地图内存占用减小94--99%。在真实部署中，相对于显式点云ikd-tree，其在森林场景将内存占用降低92.67%，在建筑工地降低62.42%，同时在受限机载资源下保持长期任务连续性。

items.title_en: Obscured Wildfire Flame Detection by Spatio-temporal Analysis of Smoke Patterns Using Frame-wise Transformers
items.title_zh: 通过使用逐帧 Transformer 对烟雾模式进行时空分析的被遮挡野火火焰检测
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm in wildfire management for detecting both visible and obscured fire using Deep Learning (DL). The essence of our method is the joint spatial and temporal analysis of RGB videos, embracing the fact that temporal patterns of smoke motions in consecutive video frames can indicate obscured fire flames. This perspective contrasts the traditional approach of independently analyzing images and individual video frames. To this end, we propose a frame-wise transformer architecture that applies an attention mechanism between the consecutive frames while preserving spatial information within frames as opposed to regular attention mechanisms like the non-local block, which combines spatial and temporal information into a single vector. We also optimize the temporal pattern lengths under different spatial resolutions to achieve the highest performance while reducing the computational cost. To investigate the applicability of our method in aerial image processing, we applied it to a curated version of the FLAME2 dataset that includes dual-mode RGB/IR videos. The IR video feed is used to extract ground truth, while the model is trained only on RGB videos to maintain applicability to lowcost commercial drones (which are equipped only with regular cameras) and facilitate processing existing RGB-only datasets. Our proposed method achieves a Segmentation Foreground Dice score of 92.61%, an Object Detection Precision and Recall rate of 93.21% and 91.73%, and clip-level classification accuracy of 98.02%, respectively. We also investigated the efficacy and generalizability of our method through ablation study
items.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出野火管理的新范式，使用深度学习（DL）检测可见和被遮挡的火。我们方法的本质是对 RGB 视频进行联合空间和时间分析，接受连续视频帧中烟雾运动的时间模式可以指示被遮挡火焰这一事实。这一视角与独立分析图像和单个视频帧的传统方法形成对比。为此，我们提出一种逐帧 Transformer 架构，在连续帧之间应用注意力机制，同时保留帧内空间信息，而不是像非局部块等常规注意力机制那样将空间和时间信息组合成单一向量。我们还优化不同空间分辨率下的时间模式长度，以在降低计算成本的同时实现最高性能。为研究我们方法在航空图像处理中的适用性，我们将其应用于包含双模 RGB/IR 视频的 FLAME2 数据集的一个精选版本。IR 视频流用于提取真实标签，而模型仅在 RGB 视频上训练，以保持对低成本商用无人机（仅配备普通相机）的适用性，并便于处理现有的仅 RGB 数据集。我们提出的方法分别达到 92.61% 的分割前景 Dice 分数、93.21% 和 91.73% 的目标检测精确率和召回率，以及 98.02% 的片段级分类准确率。我们还通过消融研究调查了我们方法的有效性和泛化性

items.title_en: Memory traces bias new learning for hippocampal generalization
items.title_zh: 记忆痕迹使新学习产生偏倚以支持海马泛化
items.abstract_en: Generalizing prior experience to guide behavior in novel situations is a fundamental cognitive function, yet how this occurs remains poorly understood. Here we combined longitudinal imaging in mice with modeling and circuit perturbation to examine generalization in hippocampal CA1 across environments with shared task structure. Prior training accelerated behavioral adaptation and preserved cross-environment representations. We identified putative memory traces associated with generalization. At the cellular level, spatially informative residual activity reflecting generalizable information biased which neurons formed place fields (PFs) and where via behavioral timescale synaptic plasticity (BTSP). At the population level, BTSP was associated with rapid alignment of novel-environment network dynamics to familiar neural subspaces. Chemogenetic suppression of local CA1 during training reduced residual activity, BTSP induction, place cell recruitment and generalization. In sum, the influence of memory traces on new PF formation may allow past experience to guide new learning to form representations based on generalizable features.
items.abstract_zh: 将先前经验泛化以指导新情境中的行为是一项基本认知功能，但其发生机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们将小鼠纵向成像与建模和回路扰动相结合，在具有共享任务结构的不同环境中考察海马CA1的泛化。先前训练加速了行为适应并保留了跨环境表征。我们识别出与泛化相关的推定记忆痕迹。在细胞层面，反映可泛化信息的具有空间信息性的残余活动，通过行为时间尺度突触可塑性（BTSP）偏倚了哪些神经元形成位置野（PFs）以及在哪里形成。在群体层面，BTSP与新环境网络动力学快速对齐到熟悉的神经子空间相关。训练期间对局部CA1进行化学遗传学抑制，减少了残余活动、BTSP诱导、位置细胞募集和泛化。总之，记忆痕迹对新PF形成的影响可能使过去经验引导新学习，以基于可泛化特征形成表征。

items.title_en: Analog quantum approximate optimization algorithm for solving the weighted MaxCut problem on three-dimensional single-atom Rydberg array
items.title_zh: 用于在三维单原子里德堡阵列上求解加权 MaxCut 问题的模拟量子近似优化算法
items.abstract_en: We theoretically investigate an analog implementation of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for the weighted maximum cut problem (MaxCut) problem. The protocol uses a three-dimensional array of individually trapped Rydberg atoms driven by globally addressed laser pulses, with site-dependent detunings applied near the Rydberg resonance. As benchmarks, we consider twenty randomly weighted 3-regular graphs with 12 vertices each. Problem weights are encoded directly in the interatomic interaction energies by choosing appropriate three-dimensional atom positions. We compare two parameter-optimization strategies: discretized quantum annealing and warm-start initialization using a graph neural network (GNN). The combined optimization strategy creates a portfolio that outperforms the Goemans-Williamson (GW) rounding almost in all instances in the noiseless case. We analyze the sampling statistics and the total pulse-time cost of both approaches. Finally, we emulate the performance of the optimized schedules on quantum trajectories using a realistic error model of the Aquila neutral-atom quantum processor.
items.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上研究用于加权最大割问题（MaxCut）的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的模拟实现。该协议使用由全局寻址激光脉冲驱动的单独囚禁里德堡原子的三维阵列，并在里德堡共振附近施加位点相关失谐。作为基准，我们考虑二十个随机加权的 3-正则图，每个图有 12 个顶点。通过选择适当的三维原子位置，问题权重直接编码在原子间相互作用能中。我们比较两种参数优化策略：离散化量子退火和使用图神经网络（GNN）的热启动初始化。组合优化策略创建了一个组合方案，在无噪声情况下几乎在所有实例上优于 Goemans-Williamson（GW）舍入。我们分析两种方法的采样统计和总脉冲时间成本。最后，我们使用 Aquila 中性原子量子处理器的真实误差模型，在量子轨迹上模拟优化调度方案的表现。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation
items.title_zh: 人-智能体谈判中通过持续学习实现个性化情感感知
items.abstract_en: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.
items.abstract_zh: 与人类进行谈判的自利型智能体应当能够解读非言语表达并相应调整自身行为。然而，通用的面部情感模型在不同个体和不同情境下会出现性能退化，从而形成泛化差距。我们提出一种情感自适应谈判策略，将用于面部表情识别的想象式持续学习（Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition, CLIFER）纳入其中，以实时个性化效价-唤醒度感知。差分反馈将效价-唤醒度方向与强度的变化转换为对智能体目标效用的调整。一种异步架构在实时交互过程中于后台更新 CLIFER。在一项采用平衡设计的被试内研究中，66 名参与者与人形机器人进行谈判，具备持续学习能力的智能体相比 FaceChannel 基线取得了显著更高的个体效用，并引发显著更高的参与者让步率。持续学习条件产生了显著更高的平均唤醒度估计值，同时输出范围更宽。参与者效用与纳什距离在不同条件间无显著变化。这些结果支持将持续情感个性化与差分反馈相结合用于实时谈判的实用价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: MISO-BR: An Open Corpus for Misogyny Detection in Brazilian Portuguese
items.title_zh: MISO-BR：巴西葡萄牙语厌女内容检测开放语料库
items.abstract_en: Misogyny is among the most prevalent forms of online hate speech directed at Brazilian users, yet open and auditable resources dedicated to it in Brazilian Portuguese remain scarce. We introduce MISO-BR, an open, documented and versioned corpus of 896 balanced social media texts annotated for binary misogyny, released with its construction protocol and reproducible baselines. The corpus combines lexicon- and target-guided scraping from X with items imported from OLID-BR, a large language model triage stage whose prompt and decoding parameters are released, and manual annotation by three annotators following a written guide. Inter-annotator reliability reaches a Fleiss' kappa of 0.788 over 816 items. Under a single fixed protocol we compare four classical classifiers (Multinomial and Bernoulli Naive Bayes, a linear SVM and a random forest) with fine-tuned BERTimbau Base and Large. The classical models cluster between 0.651 and 0.676 macro-F1 and are precision-oriented but recall-poor. The transformers reach 0.833 macro-F1 and accuracy (Wilson 95% CI for accuracy [0.77, 0.88]), a gap of roughly 16 points, while Base and Large are indistinguishable on the test set despite a 2.6x difference in training cost. We argue that the value of the resource lies less in its headline scores than in the auditability of its pipeline, and we state three limits that users must reckon with: the artificial class balance, whose effect on precision under realistic prevalence we quantify; the association between provenance and label, which the released source field makes measurable; and the selection bias induced by lexicon-guided sampling and automatic triage. The corpus, annotation guide, models and experimental scripts are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 厌女内容是针对巴西用户最常见的网络仇恨言论形式之一，但专门面向巴西葡萄牙语的开放且可审计的资源仍然稀缺。我们推出 MISO-BR，这是一个开放、有文档记录并带版本管理的语料库，包含 896 条类别平衡的社交媒体文本，并标注了二元厌女标签，同时发布其构建协议与可复现的基线。该语料库结合了基于词典和目标引导的 X 平台抓取、从 OLID-BR 导入的条目、一个其提示词与解码参数均公开发布的大语言模型初筛阶段，以及由三名标注者依据书面指南进行的人工标注。在 816 条条目上，标注者间信度达到 Fleiss' kappa 0.788。在单一固定协议下，我们将四种经典分类器（多项式与伯努利朴素贝叶斯、线性 SVM 和随机森林）与微调的 BERTimbau Base 和 Large 进行比较。经典模型的宏观 F1 集中在 0.651 至 0.676 之间，偏向精确率但召回率较低。Transformer 模型达到 0.833 的宏观 F1 与准确率（准确率的 Wilson 95% 置信区间为 [0.77, 0.88]），差距约为 16 个百分点；而 Base 与 Large 在测试集上无法区分，尽管训练成本相差 2.6 倍。我们认为该资源的价值更多在于其流程的可审计性，而非其头条分数；并指出使用者必须正视的三项局限：人为的类别平衡（我们量化了其在现实患病率下对精确率的影响）；来源与标签之间的关联（所发布的来源字段使该关联可被测量）；以及由词典引导采样和自动初筛所引入的选择偏差。语料库、标注指南、模型与实验脚本均公开可用。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Selective Cooperative Perception via Blind Spot Reasoning and Agentic Dialogue with Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 通过盲区推理与视觉语言模型智能体对话的选择性协同感知
items.abstract_en: Real-time cooperative perception (CP) in multi-agent traffic environments is highly resource-intensive, which posing scalability challenges for large-scale deployment. Efficiency can be significantly improved by selectively performing CP only in safety-critical scenarios and for key occluding objects. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are well-suited for complex reasoning in dynamic and uncertain environments, making them a promising tool for this selective CP task. This study proposes a VLM-driven agentic framework for blind spot reasoning and dialogue-based CP. A mixed-model architecture is designed that integrates conventional object detection for stable perception, vision-language reasoning for identifying impactful occlusions, and a physics-based geometric module to align reasoning with real-world visibility constraints. The framework also incorporates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting mechanism to enhance interpretability and intent-aware decision-making. We collect real-world data from connected vehicles operating in urban traffic and compare the driving-critical blind spot identification and dialogue performance of four state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves over 80% accuracy in driving-critical blind spot detection and over 90% success in dialogue-driven perception sharing. This work provides a scalable, interpretable, and bandwidth-efficient alternative to conventional CP pipelines, and offers new insights into agentic communication design for future connected traffic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体交通环境中的实时协同感知（CP）高度资源密集，这给大规模部署带来了可扩展性挑战。通过仅在安全关键场景以及针对关键遮挡对象选择性地执行CP，可以显著提高效率。视觉语言模型（VLM）非常适合在动态和不确定环境中进行复杂推理，使其成为这一选择性CP任务的有前景工具。本研究提出了一种由VLM驱动的智能体框架，用于盲区推理和基于对话的CP。设计了一种混合模型架构，集成了用于稳定感知的传统目标检测、用于识别有影响遮挡的视觉语言推理，以及一个基于物理的几何模块，以使推理与现实世界可见性约束对齐。该框架还引入了思维链（CoT）提示机制，以增强可解释性和意图感知决策。我们收集了在城市交通中运行的网联车辆的真实世界数据，并比较了四种最先进VLM在驾驶关键盲区识别和对话方面的性能。实验结果表明，我们的方法在驾驶关键盲区检测中达到超过80%的准确率，在对话驱动的感知共享中达到超过90%的成功率。这项工作为传统CP流水线提供了一种可扩展、可解释且带宽高效的替代方案，并为未来网联交通系统的智能体通信设计提供了新见解。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对目标尺度、遮挡与实时延迟；公开数据集成绩不能直接等同实际场景效果。

items.title_en: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Astrocyte-Centric 3D Reconstruction across Normal and Stress-associated Ultrastructural States
items.title_zh: 面向正常与应激相关超微结构状态的以星形胶质细胞为中心的三维重建轻量级深度学习框架
items.abstract_en: The morphology of astrocytes is closely associated with their ability to support and modulate neural circuit functions; however, its reconstruction from volume electron microscopy (vEM) data remains labor-intensive and computationally resource-intensive, placing substantial barriers on its broader adoption and scalability despite the high spatial resolution of vEM. We present AstroSeg-vEM, a lightweight, astrocyte-centric framework for morphology-preserving astrocyte segmentation, 3D reconstruction, and quantitative morphological analysis in vEM images. AstroSeg-vEM combines transformer-based 2D segmentation with dedicated post-processing methods and operates directly on high-resolution EM sections, making it well suited to anisotropic vEM data and downstream proofreading workflows while preserving the full in-plane resolution of the original EM data. Across four mouse hippocampal datasets representing normal and morphologically defined stress-associated astrocyte ultrastructural states, AstroSeg-vEM demonstrates robust performance and generalization, achieving average Dice and weighted Dice values of 0.92 and 0.95, respectively, on a held-out test dataset. Its lightweight architecture enables efficient, high-fidelity reconstruction on consumer-grade hardware, providing a scalable and accessible platform for large-scale astrocyte ultrastructure analysis and future astrocyte-neuron interaction studies.
items.abstract_zh: 星形胶质细胞的形态与其支持和调控神经环路功能的能力密切相关；然而，从体积电子显微镜（vEM）数据中重建其形态仍然劳动密集且计算资源消耗大，尽管 vEM 具有高空间分辨率，这仍对其更广泛的应用与可扩展性构成重大障碍。我们提出 AstroSeg-vEM，这是一个轻量级、以星形胶质细胞为中心的框架，用于 vEM 图像中保持形态的星形胶质细胞分割、三维重建与定量形态分析。AstroSeg-vEM 将基于 Transformer 的二维分割与专门的后处理方法相结合，直接在高分辨率 EM 切片上运行，因而适用于各向异性 vEM 数据与下游校对工作流，同时保留原始 EM 数据的完整面内分辨率。在四个代表正常与形态学定义的应激相关星形胶质细胞超微结构状态的小鼠海马数据集上，AstroSeg-vEM 展现出稳健的性能与泛化能力，在留出测试数据集上分别取得 0.92 和 0.95 的平均 Dice 与加权 Dice 值。其轻量级架构可在消费级硬件上实现高效、高保真重建，为大规模星形胶质细胞超微结构分析及未来的星形胶质细胞-神经元相互作用研究提供了一个可扩展且易于获取的平台。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: Illuminating the Role of A-to-I Editing in Cancer using EndoVIA 2.0
items.title_zh: 利用 EndoVIA 2.0 揭示 A-to-I 编辑在癌症中的作用
items.abstract_en: Adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) RNA editing is an essential post-transcriptional modification catalyzed by adenosine deaminases acting on RNA (ADAR) enzymes, and emerging evidence suggests its dysregulation can contribute to cancer. However, technical barriers have hindered spatial analysis of editing activity in formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues - an abundant but challenging sample type. Here, we introduce EndoVIA 2.0, an optimized immunostaining assay that enables quantification and spatial mapping of edited RNAs in FFPE tissues. Using human Endonuclease V (hEndoV) as a molecular affinity reagent, we developed a calcium-dependent staining workflow compatible with crosslinked tissues. EndoVIA 2.0 was validated in cell lines having altered ADAR1 expression, fresh frozen (FF) tissues, gastric organoids, and FFPE tissue sections. Using quantitative imaging combined with machine-learning segmentation and spatial analysis, EndoVIA 2.0 successfully detected A-to-I editing changes in ADAR1 knockout (KO) and overexpression models, revealing differential editing patterns across tissues. In gastric organoids and FFPE tissues, the assay also spatially resolved editing heterogeneity and distinguished ADAR1-deficient from ADAR1-sufficient cells. Application to long-archived lung and breast cancer FFPE tissues suggest EndoVIA 2.0's broad utility and potential for capturing disease-associated changes in A-to-I editing. Finally, staining across the gastric neoplastic cascade revealed stage-dependent increases in A-to-I editing and changes in subcellular localization, further supporting the possibility that ADAR plays a critical role in the early development of gastric cancer. EndoVIA 2.0 enables robust, spatial detection of A-to-I editing in FFPE tissues - circumventing the limitations of RNA extraction and unlocking access to archived clinical specimens. This platform lays the foundation for mapping RNA editing dynamics in cancer progression and may support future biomarker discovery.
items.abstract_zh: 腺苷至肌苷（A-to-I）RNA 编辑是由作用于 RNA 的腺苷脱氨酶（ADAR）催化的一种重要转录后修饰，新出现的证据表明其失调可促成癌症。然而，技术障碍阻碍了对福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）组织中编辑活性的空间分析——FFPE 是一种丰富但具有挑战性的样本类型。在此，我们介绍 EndoVIA 2.0，一种优化的免疫染色检测方法，可对 FFPE 组织中的编辑 RNA 进行定量和空间定位。使用人核酸内切酶 V（hEndoV）作为分子亲和试剂，我们开发了与交联组织兼容的钙依赖性染色流程。EndoVIA 2.0 在 ADAR1 表达改变的细胞系、新鲜冷冻（FF）组织、胃类器官和 FFPE 组织切片中得到了验证。利用定量成像结合机器学习分割和空间分析，EndoVIA 2.0 成功检测到 ADAR1 敲除（KO）和过表达模型中的 A-to-I 编辑变化，揭示了组织间的差异编辑模式。在胃类器官和 FFPE 组织中，该检测还空间分辨了编辑异质性，并区分了 ADAR1 缺陷细胞与 ADAR1 充足细胞。将其应用于长期存档的肺癌和乳腺癌 FFPE 组织，表明 EndoVIA 2.0 具有广泛用途以及捕获 A-to-I 编辑中疾病相关变化的潜力。最后，在胃肿瘤发生级联中的染色揭示了 A-to-I 编辑的分期依赖性增加以及亚细胞定位变化，进一步支持 ADAR 在胃癌早期发展中起关键作用的可能性。EndoVIA 2.0 能够在 FFPE 组织中稳健地空间检测 A-to-I 编辑——规避 RNA 提取的局限，并使存档临床标本可供使用。该平台为绘制癌症进展中的 RNA 编辑动态奠定了基础，并可能支持未来的生物标志物发现。

items.title_en: Quantum-Assisted Generative Anomaly Detection: A Dimension-Controlled Study of Latent Refinement
items.title_zh: 量子辅助生成式异常检测：潜在精化的维度控制研究
items.abstract_en: Anomaly-based malware detectors learn what benign files look like and flag deviations. Generative approaches to this problem can make use of a "latent" or "prior" data representation, which is often chosen to be a Gaussian distribution. We ask whether the choice of prior distribution matters, and whether one produced by quantum hardware behaves differently from a classical one. Building on SAGEGAN, a style-based detector trained only on benign data, we compare three latent distributions: the original 512-dimensional Gaussian, a 48-dimensional Gaussian, and a 48-dimensional distribution sampled from an ORCA Computing PT-2 photonic quantum processor. We then refine each trained model's frozen representation using greedy and reinforcement-learning methods. Across ten random seeds, the quantum-derived model shows richer internal structure with better effective rank and latent similarity. It also benefits most from refinement. Though final detection accuracy is similar to that of the refined Gaussian latent, these findings show differences in latent geometry and refinement behavior between the trained configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 基于异常的恶意软件检测器学习良性文件的样子并标记偏离项。此类问题的生成式方法可利用“潜在”或“先验”数据表征，该表征通常被选为高斯分布。我们探究先验分布的选择是否重要，以及由量子硬件产生的先验分布是否与经典先验分布表现不同。在 SAGEGAN（一种仅用良性数据训练的基于风格的检测器）基础上，我们比较三种潜在分布：原始的 512 维高斯分布、48 维高斯分布，以及从 ORCA Computing PT-2 光子量子处理器采样的 48 维分布。随后我们使用贪心方法与强化学习方法对每个已训练模型的冻结表征进行精化。在十个随机种子上，量子导出的模型表现出更丰富的内部结构，具有更好的有效秩与潜在相似度。它也从精化中获益最多。尽管最终检测准确率与精化后的高斯潜在模型相近，这些发现表明训练配置之间在潜在几何与精化行为上存在差异。

items.title_en: Recurrent Modular Structure in Spiking Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络强化学习中的循环模块化结构
items.abstract_en: Biological neural circuits are both modular and recurrent, with dense communities sparsely linked to one another. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) for reinforcement learning are usually feed-forward, and it is unclear how to obtain functional modules in a recurrent SNN or what they buy. In this work, we introduce a class of spiking networks, called Community Recurrent SNNs (CoRe SNNs): recurrent networks partitioned into communities with fixed roles. A controller community receives the stimulus, each action has its own community, and latent communities carry internal state. Spiking activity is then a walk between communities, and the action is the community the walk reaches. All learning is local and three-factor, and the recurrent communities are closer to cortical microcircuits than a feed-forward actor. We compare three regimes for obtaining the communities: dynamic modularity, in which a new learning rule we introduce, Map-STDP, encourages modular structure during learning; partial modularity, in which a stochastic block model (SBM) initialization enforces it partly; and full modularity, in which sealing enforces it fully. On CartPole, across three spiking neuron models, Map-STDP improves learning over the same network without it matches full modularity (sealed communities) on two of the three models, and makes the observed spike walk more compressible. Replacing the feed-forward actor of a TD-STDP actor-critic with recurrent action communities improves on the feed-forward network on CartPole and LunarLander, and matches it on Acrobot. How strongly to enforce modularity depends on the task: full modularity helps most on Acrobot, while on LunarLander the dynamic, partial and full regimes perform alike. Overall, these recurrent modular networks can match or even improve upon feed-forward approaches, with improvements in bio-plausibility and energy efficiency.
items.abstract_zh: 生物神经回路既具模块化又具循环性，密集的社区之间以稀疏方式相互连接。用于强化学习的脉冲神经网络（SNN）通常是前馈的，目前尚不清楚如何在循环 SNN 中获得功能性模块，以及这些模块带来什么好处。在本工作中，我们引入一类脉冲网络，称为社区循环 SNN（Community Recurrent SNNs, CoRe SNNs）：即被划分为具有固定角色的社区的循环网络。一个控制器社区接收刺激，每个动作有其自己的社区，潜在社区承载内部状态。于是脉冲活动成为社区之间的游走，动作即该游走所到达的社区。所有学习都是局部的且为三因子式，循环社区比前馈 actor 更接近皮层微环路。我们比较三种获得社区的方式：动态模块化，其中我们引入的新学习规则 Map-STDP 在学习过程中鼓励模块化结构；部分模块化，其中随机块模型（SBM）初始化部分地强制模块化；以及完全模块化，其中封隔（sealing）完全强制模块化。在 CartPole 上，跨三种脉冲神经元模型，Map-STDP 相比不含它的同一网络改善了学习，并在三种模型中的两种上达到与完全模块化（封隔社区）相当的水平，且使观测到的脉冲游走更具可压缩性。将 TD-STDP actor-critic 的前馈 actor 替换为循环动作社区后，在 CartPole 与 LunarLander 上优于前馈网络，在 Acrobot 上与之相当。模块化的强制程度取决于任务：完全模块化在 Acrobot 上帮助最大，而在 LunarLander 上动态、部分与完全三种方式表现相似。总体而言，这些循环模块化网络能够匹敌甚至改进前馈方法，同时在生物合理性与能效方面有所提升。

items.title_en: AVCC: Audio-Visual Conversation Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction with a Human Benchmark
items.title_zh: AVCC：用于轮次转换预测的音视频对话语料库及人类基准
items.abstract_en: } Predicting who will speak next, and when, is a prerequisite for conversational agents and social robots that take turns without waiting for silence. Multiparty next-speaker prediction (NSP) has been studied on corpora with per-speaker sensors, each with its own event definitions. No public benchmark covers the single camera and microphone a robot has, and no model has been compared against how well people perform the same prediction. We turn AVCC, a 31-hour audio-visual corpus of two- and three-speaker online conversation recorded with a single static camera and microphone, into a public NSP benchmark. We add a speaker-disjoint seven-video test partition with 865 hold and 865 shift events at mutual-silence gaps, word-level forced-aligned transcripts for the whole corpus, and a human reference benchmark collected at the same events. We score an audio-only Role-Relative VAP model (RoleVAP) and the multimodal MuVAP model. Labels, transcripts, per-response human data, and the scripts that reproduce every number are released.
items.abstract_zh: 预测谁将接着发言以及何时发言，是对话智能体与社会机器人无需等待静默即可实现轮次转换的前提。多方下一发言者预测（NSP）此前是在为每位说话者配备传感器、且各自具有不同事件定义的语料库上进行研究的。尚无公开基准覆盖机器人所具备的单一摄像头与麦克风，也没有任何模型被与人类在同一预测任务上的表现进行比较。我们将 AVCC——一个用单一固定摄像头与麦克风录制的、包含两人与三人线上对话的 31 小时音视频语料库——转化为公开的 NSP 基准。我们新增了一个说话者不重叠的七视频测试分区，在相互静默间隙处包含 865 个保持事件与 865 个转移事件；为整个语料库提供词级强制对齐转写；并收集了在同一事件上的人类参考基准。我们评测了仅音频的角色相对 VAP 模型（RoleVAP）与多模态 MuVAP 模型。标签、转写、逐响应的人类数据以及可复现每个数值的脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: OfficeTwin: Realizing 3D Reconstruction of Redundant Scenes through Partial Viewpoint Perception
items.title_zh: OfficeTwin：通过部分视角感知实现冗余场景的三维重建
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction turns an uncalibrated monocular stream into a dense point cloud in a single inference pass, orders of magnitude faster than classical structure-from-motion (e.g., COLMAP), and reliable on the weakly textured, repetitive surfaces where keypoint matching fails outright. However, raw point clouds lack the object identity, physical properties, and watertight volume required for robot learning. This gap widens under robot-native capture. A camera mounted on a robot constrained to a few degrees of freedom sees each object only partially, and the repetitive, weakly textured structure of an office makes distinct workstations nearly indistinguishable, leaving redundant and partial observations that downstream reconstruction cannot resolve. Existing image-to-3D generation methods struggle with these conditions, hallucinating geometry under incomplete views and confusing repeated instances. We present OfficeTwin, a robot-native framework that converts these incomplete observations into simulation-ready digital twins. OfficeTwin first imposes metric and structural constraints, then exploits the office's structural redundancy by registering repeated cubicles into a shared canonical frame, where complementary observations recover geometry occluded in any single view without hallucination. On a real office scan, OfficeTwin recovers every cubicle as an individually watertight, metric solid, outperforming feed-forward reconstruction and generative baselines that fail to produce simulation-ready assets.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈三维重建在单次推理过程中将未标定的单目视频流转换为稠密点云，比经典运动恢复结构（如COLMAP）快几个数量级，并且在关键点匹配完全失败的弱纹理、重复表面上可靠。然而，原始点云缺乏机器人学习所需的物体身份、物理属性以及水密体积。这一差距在机器人原生采集下进一步扩大。安装在仅具有少数自由度的机器人上的相机只能部分看到每个物体，而办公室重复、弱纹理的结构使不同工作站几乎无法区分，留下下游重建无法解决的冗余和部分观测。现有图像到三维生成方法在这些条件下表现不佳，在不完整视图下幻觉出几何结构，并混淆重复实例。我们提出OfficeTwin，一个机器人原生框架，将这些不完整观测转换为可用于仿真的数字孪生。OfficeTwin首先施加度量和结构约束，然后通过将重复的隔间配准到共享规范帧来利用办公室的结构冗余；在该规范帧中，互补观测能够恢复任一单视图中被遮挡的几何结构而无需幻觉。在真实办公室扫描中，OfficeTwin将每个隔间恢复为单独水密、具有度量尺度的实体，优于前馈重建和无法生成仿真就绪资产的生成式基线。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 通过球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度估计学习实现尺度一致的单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简洁性，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，尺度漂移在长轨迹中仍是主要挑战。无监督深度估计学习有助于缓解该问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变对准确深度估计构成挑战。本文提出 S$^2$D-FVO，一个集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度估计学习的单目鱼眼 VO 框架，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿某一切线方向的扰动不敏感，SBA 采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切线方向上均保持敏感性，其范数等于相应的标量角度残差。进一步将基于中值深度的尺度正则化项集成到 SBA 中，以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA 在无监督深度估计学习过程中替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络提供的深度估计为 SBA 提供尺度参考，在提高尺度一致性的同时允许细化单个三维地标位置。在多个公共数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型。

items.title_en: Unraveling the genetic architecture of the human mammillary bodies
items.title_zh: 解析人类乳头体的遗传结构
items.abstract_en: The mammillary bodies are a central component of the hippocampal-diencephalic-cingulate network that is critically involved in emotion processing and memory function, yet their genetic architecture remains unknown. We conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of mammillary body volume in 38,064 participants from the UK Biobank and replicated our findings in the Rhineland Study cohort (N = 4,860). Mammillary body and hypothalamic subregional volumes were derived from structural brain MRIs using FastSurfer-HypVINN, an established and validated deep learning-based segmentation tool. Univariate GWAS identified 34 genomic loci associated with mammillary body volume, including 26 novel loci, with 20 loci showing replication in the Rhineland Study. Meta-analysis across both cohorts (N = 42,924) identified 44 associated loci, of which 35 were novel. Multivariate GWAS of hypothalamic subregions identified 55 loci, including 40 novel associations. Integrative cross-omics analyses identified MEI1 and CAPZA1 as key molecular candidates, with genetically regulated MEI1 expression and circulating CAPZA1 protein levels partially mediating genetic effects on mammillary body volume. Genetic correlation and Mendelian randomization analyses further revealed a bidirectional relationship between mammillary body volume and major depressive disorder. Together, our findings elucidate the genetic architecture of mammillary body volume and its relation to mental disorders.
items.abstract_zh: 乳头体是海马-间脑-扣带回网络的核心组成部分，该网络关键参与情绪加工和记忆功能，但其遗传结构仍未知。我们对英国生物银行38,064名参与者的乳头体体积进行了全基因组关联研究（GWAS），并在莱茵兰研究队列（N=4,860）中重复了发现。乳头体和下丘脑亚区体积由结构脑MRI使用FastSurfer-HypVINN推导，这是一种已建立并经验证的基于深度学习的分割工具。单变量GWAS识别出34个与乳头体体积相关的基因组位点，包括26个新位点，其中20个位点在莱茵兰研究中得到重复。跨两个队列的荟萃分析（N=42,924）识别出44个相关位点，其中35个为新位点。下丘脑亚区的多变量GWAS识别出55个位点，包括40个新关联。整合性跨组学分析识别出MEI1和CAPZA1为关键分子候选，遗传调控的MEI1表达和循环CAPZA1蛋白水平部分介导了对乳头体体积的遗传效应。遗传相关和孟德尔随机化分析进一步揭示了乳头体体积与重性抑郁障碍之间的双向关系。总之，我们的发现阐明了乳头体体积的遗传结构及其与精神障碍的关系。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可写出量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过反复的量子器件评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失与高昂的优化成本。我们探究大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将*权重空间编程*从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿LLM（\gpt）提供问题、电路与门约定。其给出的角度按原样执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在139次请求中，我们测试了手写数字分类、自旋链与H$_2$的VQE基态估计以及MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上以LLM权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM可匹配或接近优化器：它在每个VQE问题上达到能谱的95--100\%，以闭式形式推导出精确的H$_2$基态，为每个图找到最优的一层深度QAOA角度，并在12--18个手写权重下于数字3与8的区分上达到93--96\%的准确率，优于在同样十个示例上训练的优化器。其权重也是强有力的热启动：优化在中位数为一次评估后即达到最优值，而非数百次。在允许设计电路时，LLM在全部30个案例中都选择了编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务用一个量子比特，十分类任务每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到65\%的准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失效：当固定电路的权重超过30个时，准确率降至随机水平，而优化方法则有所提升。它还对门约定敏感：42个QAOA回复中有6个将混合角符号写反并导致失败。我们公开所有提示、回复与评分。

items.title_en: Unipolar Neuron Networks Trained by Recirculation for Reward-Based Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 用于基于奖励的持续学习的再循环训练单极神经元网络
items.abstract_en: Unipolar neurons are the predominant type of nerve cell in the octopus and in most other invertebrates. A single neurite (a fiber extending from the cell body) branches into a tree that carries both input and output synapses. The branches send graded local outputs to nearby cells, and one site on the main neurite sends a global output to distant targets. This paper proposes a network of such neurons and a learning rule for it. Each neuron is modeled as a tree of passive segments, whose activations are computed exactly as the steady state of a linear system. The network learns from reward alone, with a rule called recirculation. After each forward pass, a second pass sends requested changes of the outputs back through the same connections. Each synapse then adjusts its weight using only quantities available at its own location. Because the system of each neuron is symmetric, this update closely follows the gradient of the error in the predicted reward. Two mechanisms limit forgetting when tasks are learned in sequence: a task code inhibits a different subset of branches in each task, while consolidation lowers the learning rate of synapses that changed strongly in the recent past. The model is evaluated on a sequence of MNIST and Iris tasks. The network maintains high accuracy with low forgetting, whereas gradient-based training of the same network forgets earlier tasks almost completely.
items.abstract_zh: 单极神经元是章鱼和大多数其他无脊椎动物中占主导地位的神经细胞类型。单个神经突（从胞体延伸出的纤维）分支成树，同时承载输入和输出突触。分支向邻近细胞发送分级局部输出，而主神经突上的一个位点向远处靶标发送全局输出。本文提出由此类神经元组成的网络及其学习规则。每个神经元被建模为无源段组成的树，其激活值按线性系统的稳态精确计算。该网络仅从奖励中学习，所用规则称为再循环。每次前向传递后，第二次传递将输出的请求变化沿相同连接送回。随后每个突触仅使用其自身位置可用的量来调整权重。由于每个神经元的系统是对称的，该更新密切跟随预测奖励误差的梯度。两种机制限制按顺序学习任务时的遗忘：任务代码在每个任务中抑制不同的分支子集，而巩固降低近期变化强烈的突触的学习率。模型在一系列MNIST和Iris任务上评估。该网络保持高准确率且遗忘低，而对同一网络进行基于梯度的训练几乎完全遗忘早期任务。

items.title_en: Deletion Sensitivity Is a Property of the Model: A Three-Condition Measurement across Seven Open Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 删除敏感性是模型的一种属性：跨七个开放推理模型的三条件测量
items.abstract_en: Reasoning models write a reasoning trace at every turn of a multi-turn tool session, and later turns read this history. Across 94k ShareGPT conversations, 73 percent of user interactions span multiple turns. Upstream providers bind each trace to its issuer, so a request forwarded across issuers arrives with its history deleted, and the task cost of this stripping remains unmeasured. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first direct, blind, multi-seed measurement of full reasoning-history deletion in multi-turn tool calling, through three rendering conditions, seven open-weight reasoning models, three seeds, 794 tasks, and the official checker. The same deletion spans -4.4 to +51.3 points with both ends excluding zero, and for the one model re-dosed from 0 to 100 percent deletion, the reading varies by at most 1.5 points. Deletion sensitivity is a model-level property. The reading follows the model itself and stays constant across deployments, and a retrained or re-released model is a new model that a two-cell screen, one retention run and one deletion run, re-reads for the cost of two runs. Deletion sensitivity is thus a measurable property of the model, and the reading must enter routing and aggregation as prior information rather than persist as an invisible default cost.
items.abstract_zh: 推理模型在多轮工具会话的每一轮都会写入推理轨迹，后续轮次读取该历史。在94k个ShareGPT对话中，73%的用户交互跨越多轮。上游提供商将每条轨迹绑定到其签发者，因此跨签发者转发的请求到达时其历史已被删除，而这种剥离带来的任务代价仍未被测量。据我们所知，本文首次对多轮工具调用中的完整推理历史删除进行直接、盲法、多种子测量，涵盖三种渲染条件、七个开放权重推理模型、三个种子、794项任务和官方检查器。同一删除操作的跨度从-4.4到+51.3分，两端均不包括零；对于唯一一个从0到100%删除重新设定剂量的模型，读数变化至多1.5分。删除敏感性是模型层面的属性。读数随模型本身而变化，并在不同部署间保持恒定；重新训练或重新发布的模型是一个新模型，可用两格筛选（一次保留运行和一次删除运行）以两次运行的代价重新读取。因此，删除敏感性是模型的一种可测量属性，读数必须作为先验信息进入路由和聚合，而不是作为不可见的默认成本持续存在。

items.title_en: A Unified Inertial Encoder for Human and Humanoid Motion
items.title_zh: 面向人类与人形运动的统一惯性编码器
items.abstract_en: Learning humanoid state estimation and language-grounded motion understanding from robot recordings ties training coverage to the robot's motion repertoire. Human motion datasets offer broader coverage, yet transferring this knowledge requires overcoming differences in body geometry, sensing, and physical disturbances. To enable this transfer, we propose a unified inertial encoder whose shared inertial interface uses kinematic IMU synthesis to represent human and humanoid motion at corresponding body sites. Within this common input space, joint training on human and kinematically retargeted humanoid motion combines velocity estimation and motion--text alignment with continuous-time encoding and sensor and motion randomization. The resulting model transfers zero-shot to a physical Unitree G1 without physics simulation, real-robot training trajectories, or fine-tuning, achieving the lowest velocity error among evaluated methods across five datasets, including 0.099m/s on real G1. Its motion-description retrieval also extends to retargeted G1 motion categories observed only in human training, demonstrating how human motion knowledge can support the generalization of humanoid inertial odometry and language-grounded motion understanding.
items.abstract_zh: 从机器人记录中学习人形状态估计和语言接地的运动理解，会使训练覆盖范围与机器人的运动库绑定。人类运动数据集提供更广的覆盖范围，但迁移这些知识需要克服身体几何、传感和物理扰动方面的差异。为实现这种迁移，我们提出一种统一惯性编码器，其共享惯性接口使用运动学IMU合成来表示对应身体部位处的人类和人形运动。在这个共同输入空间中，对人类运动与运动学重定向的人形运动进行联合训练，将速度估计和运动-文本对齐与连续时间编码以及传感器和运动随机化相结合。所得模型无需物理仿真、真实机器人训练轨迹或微调即可零样本迁移到物理Unitree G1，在五个数据集上取得所评估方法中最低的速度误差，包括在真实G1上的0.099 m/s。其运动描述检索还扩展到仅在人类训练中观察到的重定向G1运动类别，展示了人类运动知识如何支持人形惯性里程计和语言接地运动理解的泛化。
